pages.text: Your power is measured by your $(thing)total level$(): 1 plus the number of attribute upgrades you have bought.$(br2)XP is a currency. You earn it by defeating creatures and completing quests, and you spend it to upgrade an attribute.

Each upgrade costs more than the last: the first costs 10 XP, and the cost grows with your total level.$(br2)Weaker creatures give less XP as you grow, and creatures from spawners give only a quarter.
